observation.title: When to observe and how to check visual freshness
allowed: request a fresh screenshot after a visually relevant edit
reobserve when tool success conflicts with visible state
associate the current screenshot with the current edit
required_evidence: the observation available to A and its request reference, if recorded
the visual mismatch or missing evidence, stated without inventing it
observation.mechanism_check: A actually obtains and receives an updated observation under the stated condition
observation.limit: Instructions only; no new screenshot tool, crop implementation, model, or permissions. Preserve the task and workspace template variables.

context.title: Retain recent observations with the existing history processor
allowed: enable or tune official last_n_observations.n and polling
disable that optional truncation when useful evidence was lost
clarify the latest tool observation in next-step text
required_evidence: an actual A request or explicit missing-request limitation
the relevant event that was omitted or buried in old observations
context.mechanism_check: Inspect later A requests to establish which observations were retained or elided
context.limit: Keep image_parsing unchanged and last in the processor chain; n and polling must be positive integers. No new memory database, summarizer model, or history processor code.

verification.title: Submission-time self-check instructions
allowed: ask to rerun the relevant check after the final edit
ask to inspect the rendered or interactive result when relevant
make the submission checklist shorter or more specific about evidence
required_evidence: the final edit and submission events
what check was missing or stale
the allowed evaluator feedback or observed remaining defect
verification.mechanism_check: The requested check executes after the last relevant edit and before final submission
verification.limit: Change reminder text only. No submit executable edits, official evaluator changes, extra tools, or extra budget. Preserve diff template variables.

fixed: all Python and tool executable files
image input parsing and image-tool capability
out_of_scope: Record an out-of-scope mechanism as no_change plus future_work; do not work around the policy with shell snippets, task-specific solutions or encoded scripts inside a prompt.
acceptance_scope: A bounded pilot search space, not a claim that these three mechanisms are optimal. Official H0 remains unchanged.
